name: hero-walk
description: An own hero's walk and run (WM_ROM_OUT/herowalk of rom.test.tsx: the hero fixture with a nine frame walk at 12 fps and no run, wm_data 28): player 1 walks right, every frame of the walk at its speed (a new frame each five game frames), stops, then double-taps right and runs with the walk twice as fast. The checkpoints follow the walk frame by frame once the start's blinking is over (222-237) and the run (300-303).
